youtube.title: Archimedes found out the crown was fake mid-bath 🛁💀 #shorts
youtube.caption:
Archimedes' eureka moment, but it's a group chat. 🛁👑

The king just wanted to know if his crown was real gold... the whole city of Syracuse got way more than an answer.

Would you have run outside too? 👇

Parody · fictional chat. Based on the famous legend of Archimedes, King Hiero II's gold crown and the bath that made him shout "Eureka!" (c. 250 BC).

#archimedes #eureka #ancientgreece #historymemes #history #science #shorts

hook.say: A king asked Archimedes one question about gold. The whole city saw way too much.
